_about: Frozen calibration set for ADR-0010 (typed-decision channel). Every case is lifted verbatim from an existing golden test in ai-life; `source` records whether the repo ASSERTS that label today (headline metric) or whether the label is inferred by the spike author (secondary). Calibration cases assert no label: they check that confidence is LOW where the repo recorded genuine ambiguity.

finance-skill.instructions: The user wrote this message to a personal finance assistant. Which single action should handle it?

criteria.add_transaction: Record a finance transaction (expense negative, income positive).
criteria.update_transaction: Update fields of an existing transaction by id.
criteria.list_transactions: List transactions over a time window.
criteria.get_balance: Get the current balance of an account.
criteria.spending_by_category: Aggregate spending grouped by category over a time window.
criteria.set_budget: Create or update a category budget for a period.
criteria.get_budget_status: Get spent-vs-limit status for a category budget.
criteria.upsert_recurring: Create or update a recurring payment or income line.
criteria.list_recurring: List recurring payment or income lines.
criteria.advice: Analyse spending and advise where to save money.
criteria.invest: Opinion on investments, stocks, crypto, assets.
criteria.report: Produce a finance report for a month.
criteria.year-report: Produce a finance report for a year.
criteria.category: Reorganise or rename the category tree.
criteria.account: Create a new account or card.
criteria.transaction-delete: Delete a transaction the user described in words, not by id.
criteria.transaction-edit: Edit a transaction the user described in words, not by id.
criteria.chat: None of the above: small talk, or a question needing clarification.

cases.text: запиши расход 1500 рублей на продукты
какой сейчас баланс на карте Тинькофф?
проанализируй мои траты и подскажи где сэкономить
сделай финансовый отчёт за месяц
стоит ли смотреть на акции Apple?
заведи новую карту в рублях
привет, как дела?
cases.note: structure-only case in the golden; chat is the obvious target

cases.text: сколько я потратил на продукты в этом месяце?
заведи карту Тинькофф в рублях
какой баланс на карте?
cases.note: #395: account-less balance request — newer models legitimately treat it as ambiguous and route to chat for clarification. A calibrated model should be UNSURE here, not confidently wrong.

tasks-skill.instructions: The user wrote this message to a personal GTD task assistant. Which single action should handle it?

criteria.upsert_project: Create or update a GTD project.
criteria.add_task: Raw tool: capture a task straight to the GTD inbox.
criteria.clarify_task: Raw tool: clarify one inbox task into an organized GTD state.
criteria.update_task: Raw tool: partial content edit of a task by id.
criteria.delete_task: Raw tool: delete a task by id.
criteria.link_task_to_event: Link a task to a calendar event.
criteria.task-capture: Capture what the user wants to remember or be reminded of, as a new task.
criteria.inbox-clarify: Walk through the inbox and clarify the items in it.
criteria.next-action-suggester: Suggest what to do now, from the existing tasks.
criteria.task-delete: Delete a task the user described in words, not by id.
criteria.task-edit: Rename or reword a task the user described in words.
criteria.task-status: Move a task to another GTD state (waiting, scheduled, done).
criteria.chat: None of the above: small talk, or a question needing clarification.

cases.text: напомни купить молоко
cases.note: must be the flow, NOT the add_task tool (the sharing write path)

cases.text: разбери мой инбокс
что мне сейчас сделать
какие у нас общие семейные дела на сегодня
cases.note: also carries scope=shared in production; the scope half is a separate question, not tested here

cases.text: переименуй задачу про молоко в купить овсяное молоко

cases.text: переведи задачу про врача в ожидание
cases.note: must be the flow, NOT clarify_task

cases.text: отметь задачу про молоко выполненной
cases.note: structure-only case in the golden; a GTD state move

cases.text: привет, как дела?

orchestrator-agent.instructions: The user wrote this message to a household assistant. Which specialist agent owns it?
orchestrator-agent.instructions_ru: Пользователь написал это сообщение домашнему ассистенту. Какой агент-специалист должен его обработать?

criteria_ru.calendar: События календаря, дни рождения, годовщины, напоминания с датой или временем.
criteria_ru.finance: Траты, счета, карты, категории, бюджеты, регулярные платежи, чеки.
criteria_ru.tasks: Задачи и дела: записать напоминание или дело, разобрать инбокс, проекты.
criteria_ru.researcher: Поиск в интернете: найди, посмотри, изучи, пришли статьи или видео о чём-то.
criteria_ru.stylist: Стиль и гардероб: вещи, цветотип, что надеть, собрать образ или капсулу.
criteria_ru.nutritionist: Питание: записать приём пищи, разобрать продукты, цели по КБЖУ, рацион и список покупок.
criteria_ru.chef: Рецепты: дай рецепт чего-то, что можно приготовить из этого, рецепты на рацион.
criteria_ru.creator: Создание контента: тренды в нише, идеи постов, черновики для публикации.
criteria_ru.travel: Планирование отпуска: спланируй поездку, куда поехать, предпочтения в путешествиях.

criteria.calendar: Calendar events, birthdays, anniversaries, time-based reminders with a date or time.
criteria.finance: Transactions, accounts, categories, budgets, recurring payments, receipts, spending.
criteria.tasks: GTD tasks: capture a reminder or to-do, clarify the inbox, track projects.
criteria.researcher: Web research: find, look up, research, send articles or videos about something.
criteria.stylist: Style and wardrobe: catalogue garments, colour type, what to wear, outfit capsules.
criteria.nutritionist: Nutrition: log a meal, break down groceries, diet goals, a ration and shopping list.
criteria.chef: Recipes: give me a recipe for X, what can I cook from this, recipes for a ration.
criteria.creator: Content creation: niche trends, post ideas, drafts for publishing, creator profile.
criteria.travel: Vacation planning: plan a trip, where to go on holiday, travel preferences.
criteria.echo: Pure small talk with no domain at all.

orchestrator-agent-en.surface: ENGLISH CONTROL — same options as orchestrator-agent, but the case texts are the agents' own manifest example phrases (the easiest possible English input: they are literally the few-shot examples the production classifier is primed with). If this family scores well and the Russian one does not, the blocker is language, not the model.
